PortReuse

sqllang.dll

NetAgent

sqllang.dll

sqllang.dll

sqllang.dll

and shown in Figure 5.
Figure 5. Log generated during hooks installation

skip-2.0
to be more resilient to MSSQL updates and to potentially target multiple
sqllang.dll

skip-2.0
are related to authentication and event logging. The targeted functions include:
CPwdPolicyManager::ValidatePwdForLogin
CSECAuthenticate::AuthenticateLoginIdentity

IssueLoginSuccessReport

XeSqlPkg::ual_instrument_called::Publish

CPwdPolicyManager::ValidatePwdForLogin
), which is responsible for validating the password provided for a given user. In the case where a different password is provided, the original function is called.
Figure 6. Hex-Rays output of the procedure responsible for matching the password provided at login with the hardcoded string

SSH backdoors previously discovered by ESET.

skip-2.0
is installed in-memory, while in the case of the SSH backdoors the
sshd

and
IssueLoginSuccessReport

XeSqlPkg::sql_batch_completed::Publish

XeSqlPkg::login::Publish

XeSqlPkg::ual_instrument_called::Publish

sqllang.dll

GitHub repository

Inner-Loader

skip-2.0
